nucleus.rule: Otsu's threshold on the healthy reference's DAPI pixels inside cells (256 bins of width 1); the nucleus region is a cell's pixels at or above it.

markers.rule: Otsu's threshold on the healthy reference's whole-cell means of the marker (256 bins of width 1 on 0-255): the first split maximising the between-class variance; a cell is positive when its mean is at or above it. The same value is applied to every participant and every measurement condition.
